items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: I just enjoyed working for Cal.

ctx.x: Yeah, he couldn't adjust to that, to sit there while the group played four or five songs and he'd come in and play just a couple of things. He had to be a part of what was happening, like. Well, I remember working with Cal was just great for me. It was one of the best jobs I ever had in terms of being musical, relationships, good feeling with the guys in the band. The work was not overly...Cal spent most of the time on the West Coast, as you remember.

I wasn't doing a whole lot of heavy traveling. When we went to New York it was always first class. I just enjoyed working for Cal. And Carl Burnett was the drummer at the time. Armando Peraza. It was an education for me to play in the group...

And then we got extra monies, like...He had the van. We would drive the van, we would keep the van between Carl and I, when we was traveling. Because Carl had most of the instruments, which was drums...By the time he broke the drums down... And there was the vibes, which went in cases, and that was it.
